comment: The suites scripts/db-conformance.mjs runs against a real database.
A part's named invariant suite goes in `invariant`; the conformance suites
its change affects go in `conformance`. Both are paths from the repository
root. The runner fails when a named suite is missing, when any test in one
of them is skipped, and when a run ends with zero tests having executed.
It is empty because no product invariant or conformance suite exists on
this tree yet, and an empty manifest is a failure, not a pass. See
docs/agents/database-conformance.md for why that is deliberate.
